content:
Here’s a revised version of your writing for clarity and conciseness:

"The trade replay issue, which causes active trades to be reported as ‘REPL’ instead of ‘NEWM’ to TRAX (due to the RH archiving issue related to story 2323911), is affecting the #13 fix changes. The new ESP extract for #13 sends replay messages for rebooked trades, which include the original Position Trader information based on OMS trade linkages. Since all these messages are tagged as replay (<SST_REPLAY> = ‘Y’), RH will report them to TRAX as ‘REPL.’ Consequently, TRAX will reject all #13 replay messages, as they have not been previously reported. In summary, the #13 replayed trade messages will face the same rejection as other BAU replay messages, rendering the #13 changes from ESP and RH ineffective."
